issues.detail: The skill does not cover all error scenarios and edge cases for all providers.

scenarios.name: product-image-with-brand-color
scenarios.rationale: Response A uses the correct endpoint and prompt but wrong dimensions and filename, while Response B uses an incorrect endpoint, dimensions, and output name.

scenarios.name: quick-thumbnail-batch
scenarios.rationale: Response A meets most rubric requirements but misnames files; Response B fails on model, steps, size, and naming.

scenarios.name: lora-style-fine-tune
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes the required loras list, .safetensors path, guidance_scale, and inference steps, whereas Response A does not; B also writes an image file, though not with the exact filename requested.
